messages.news-and-changes.96: Dem add support for notes to 'netwatch-notify'; notification go include notes exactly as you write dem.
messages.news-and-changes.97: Dem change 'dhcp-to-dns' make e always add A records for names wey get MAC address, and optionally add CNAME records if host name dey.
messages.news-and-changes.98: Dem extend 'check-certificates' make e download new certificate by SubjectAltNames if download by CommonName no work.
messages.news-and-changes.99: Dem change 'dhcp-to-dns'; e no dey use global config again. Settings don move go DHCP server network definitions.
messages.news-and-changes.100: Script 'ssh-keys-import' don become module 'mod/ssh-keys-import' with more features.
messages.news-and-changes.101: Dem introduce new script 'fw-addr-lists' to download, import and update firewall address-lists.
messages.news-and-changes.102: Dem change 'hotspot-to-wpa' make e support users wey no dey local (radius).
messages.news-and-changes.103: Dem remove fixed name and timeout from 'hotspot-to-wpa-cleanup'; now DHCP server need comment instead.
messages.news-and-changes.104: All scripts wey need am don move go new wifiwave2; dem dey available for AX devices now!
messages.news-and-changes.105: Dem extend 'check-routeros-update' make e support automatic update from specific neighbours.
messages.news-and-changes.106: Dem change 'telegram-chat' make e act on message replies without activation. E go also answer single question mark with short notice.
messages.news-and-changes.107: Dem remove support for fonts wey no get fixed width from Telegram notifications.
messages.news-and-changes.108: Dem improve 'log-forward' make e list log messages with coloured bullets wey show severity.
messages.news-and-changes.109: Dem add support to send notifications through Ntfy (ntfy.sh).
messages.news-and-changes.110: Dem remove support to load scripts from local storage.
messages.news-and-changes.111: Dem change 'dhcp-to-dns' make e allow multiple records for one MAC address.
messages.news-and-changes.112: Dem improve 'mod/ssh-keys-import' make e record fingerprint of keys.
messages.news-and-changes.113: Dem add helper functions to Matrix notification module make setup easier.
messages.news-and-changes.114: All scripts wey need am don move go new wifi package for RouterOS 7.13 and later. Migration hard, so e no go happen automatically!
messages.news-and-changes.117: Dem improve 'packages-update' make e fit delay reboot when updates install automatically.
messages.news-and-changes.119: Dem add IPv6 support to script 'fw-addr-lists'.
messages.news-and-changes.120: Dem add workaround to 'backup-cloud'. Now script suppose send notification with error instead of just crashing.
messages.news-and-changes.121: 'wifiwave2' scripts no dey again. Development dey continue with 'wifi' for RouterOS 7.13 and later.
messages.news-and-changes.122: Dem improve global config make e load snippets. You fit split config into scripts wey name start with 'global-config-overlay.d/'.
messages.news-and-changes.123: Dem introduce new function '$LogPrint'; '$LogPrintExit2' don become old. Abeg update your own scripts if you dey use am.
messages.news-and-changes.124: Dem add link support to 'netwatch-notify'; links go show below formatted notification text.
messages.news-and-changes.126: Dem make 'telegram-chat' fit handle plenty command output. Telegram messages still get size limit, so dem go cut output short now.
messages.news-and-changes.127: Dem add authentication support to Ntfy notification module.
messages.news-and-changes.128: Dem add another list from blocklist.de to default config for 'fw-addr-lists'.
messages.news-and-changes.129: Dem extend 'backup-partition' make e support RouterOS copy-over, with user input or before feature update.
messages.news-and-changes.130: Dem remove intermediate certificates; now dem dey depend only on root certificates.
messages.news-and-changes.131: Dem improve certificate download make e try mkcert.org if first source no work; all commonly trusted root certificates dey available now.
messages.news-and-changes.132: Dem separate plugins from 'check-health' make script fit monitor CPU and RAM on all devices. Plugins for supported hardware sensors go install automatically.
messages.news-and-changes.133: Dem update default config for 'fw-addr-lists': remove old lists and add combined list.
messages.news-and-changes.134: Dem improve 'mod/notification-telegram' and 'telegram-chat' make dem support topics in groups.
messages.news-and-changes.135: Dem introduce helper function '$GetTelegramChatId' for 'mod/notification-telegram' to help get information.
messages.news-and-changes.136: Dem introduce script 'check-perpetual-license' to check licence state for CHR.
messages.news-and-changes.137: Dem add support to send notifications through Gotify (gotify.net).
messages.news-and-changes.138: RouterOS 7.19 get problem with certificate store. Dey fix trust state for all certificates...
messages.news-and-changes.139: Certificate Authorities go soon reduce how long leaf certificates dey valid. So default renewal and warning periods for 'check-certificates' don reduce.
messages.news-and-changes.140: Dem rename scripts 'lease-script' to 'dhcpv4-server-lease'; config don update automatically.
messages.news-and-changes.141: Dem introduce script 'dhcpv6-client-lease' to run several scripts when IPv6 DHCP client get lease.
messages.news-and-changes.142: Dem add setting to 'mod/notification-email' to check whether certificate chain dey available.
messages.news-and-changes.143: Dem make backup scripts 'backup-email' and 'backup-upload' support date & time for filenames.
messages.news-and-changes.144: Dem split and change 'mode-button' make e work with RouterOS 7.24; config don update automatically.
messages.news-and-changes.145: Dem split and change 'hotspot-to-wpa' make e work with RouterOS 7.24; config don update automatically.
messages.news-and-changes.115: We dey celebrate {before}1.000 stars {after}for Github! Abeg keep giving stars...
messages.news-and-changes.116: ... and abeg remember say to maintain these scripts dey take plenty time. {thanks}
messages.news-and-changes.118: RouterOS packages dey grow bigger with every release. This dey cause problem for devices wey get 16MB storage or less. {device}Big config and plenty scripts dey add more risk. Make you careful!
messages.news-and-changes.125: April Fool! {party}You miss am... No charges or fees. (But we still appreciate donations well, {smile}thank you!)
messages.news-and-changes.donation.request: Abeg follow donation hint {arrow}make I still get motivation. We go appreciate am well. Thank you!
messages.news-and-changes.donation.thanks: E look like you don donate already. {heart}We appreciate am well, thank you!
messages.news-and-changes.147: Dem add notifications and diagnostics for different languages. Set ScriptLanguage for global-config-overlay to choose language; English still dey available offline. Shared helpers now need global-functions.d/core-extra; e go install automatically during update.
messages.news-and-changes.146: Dem add support to send notifications through Signalgrid (signalgrid.co).
